item.title: Deadly blasts at market and hospital raise fears of renewed Boko Haram insurgency in Nigeria
item.summary: Nigeria suicide bombings in Maiduguri killed at least 23 people and wounded over 100 others in deadly attacks targeting a hospital and market Monday night.

item.title: Iran regime hides in bunkers as civilians left exposed without adequate bomb shelters or sirens
item.summary: Iranian civilians are complaining about a lack of bomb shelters and warning systems as Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps officials hide in bunkers during strikes.

item.title: Next US move on Iran: Seize Kharg Island, secure uranium or risk ground war escalation
item.summary: Military analysts discuss three paths for U.S.-Iran conflict: capturing Iran's economic lifeline at Kharg Island, full invasion or securing nuclear sites.

item.title: EU pushes for end of Iran war in a manner where 'everybody saves face'
item.summary: The European Union is reportedly consulting with Gulf countries about possible ways Iran, Israel and the U.S. could end the war in a manner where "everybody saves face."

item.title: Top Iranian official, commander killed in strike, Israel defense minister says
item.summary: Iran's Supreme National Security Council secretary Ali Larijani and Basij Commander Gholamreza Soleimani have been "eliminated," the Israel Defense Forces said.

item.title: Why Gulf states aren’t joining the war against Iran — despite attacks on their soil
item.summary: Gulf states maintain restraint despite reported Iranian attacks on Saudi Arabia, UAE, Bahrain, Qatar and Kuwait, prioritizing regional stability.

item.title: Hamas reasserts control in Gaza as Iran war dominates regional attention and global focus
item.summary: Hamas reportedly reasserts control in Gaza as Iran war shifts international focus, according to analysts raising serious doubts about postwar planning.

item.title: New terror group with reported Iran ties claims 4 attacks across Europe
item.summary: Harakat Ashab al-Yamin al-Islamiyya attacks on European Jewish institutions may be linked to Iranian proxy networks, according to security analysts and Israeli officials.

item.title: US warns Iraq must act against Iran-backed militia attacks on American assets
item.summary: Iran-backed Popular Mobilization Forces have been accused of attacking U.S. assets in Iraq as Prime Minister Mohammed Shia al-Sudani's government told to rein in terror proxies.

item.title: Pope Leo urges war leaders to halt fighting after deadly strike on school sparks outrage
item.summary: Pope Leo XIV called Sunday for an immediate ceasefire in the war involving Iran, urgently urging world leaders to halt violence after deadly strikes hit schools and civilian areas.
